description: This file defines the StorageBackend class which implements the ISyncBackend interface for managing note synchronization with a file storage system using Android's DocumentFile API. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving notes, as well as validating storage configuration.

classes.name: StorageBackend
classes.description: Implements synchronization backend for file storage, managing notes via Android's DocumentFile API.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if storage location is accessible and permissions are granted.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note file in storage and returns its SyncNote representation.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note file with new content, possibly renaming it.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note file from storage.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a note from storage as a SyncNote object.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all note files in storage.
